title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — October 20, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B7.1)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.4 (Peaked October 20, 2026 at 18:36 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: C3.5 (Peaked October 20, 2026 at 02:45 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 380 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.67)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Little burst of solar energy! 🔥🌎

Several active regions are bright across the Sun today, especially near the right limb, while the coronagraph shows no clear large outward structure.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
